name: How do I choose the right commercial restoration company?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right commercial restoration company?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a commercial restoration company, look for licensed and insured professionals with experience in commercial properties. Check for certifications from organizations like the IICRC, which indicates industry standards for restoration. Review their reputation through client testimonials and ensure they offer 24/7 emergency services and can work directly with your insurance provider. Local companies often understand regional challenges best.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a licensed, insured, and certified company with commercial experience, good references, 24/7 service, and insurance coordination.
